parameters.command: =powershell -NoProfile -Command "cd 'C:/smock-level2-copilot'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force done | Out-Null; foreach ($i in @({{ $('Kiểm + chuyển thành lệnh ghi').first().json.ok_ids.map(x => "'" + x + "'").join(',') }})) { Get-ChildItem outbox -Recurse -Filter ($i + '.*') | ForEach-Object { git mv $_.FullName ('done/' + $_.Name) } }; git commit -m 'done'; git push"
